points: Remove the steaks and butter (see pantry for amount) from your fridge to allow them to come up to room temperature.
Chop the potatoes into 2cm chunks (peel first if you prefer).
steps.title: Start the Prep

points: Pour the boiling water into a large saucepan with ½ tsp salt for the potatoes.
Add the potatoes to the water and cook until you can easily slip a knife through, 15-18 mins.
steps.title: Boil the Potatoes

points: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on high heat.
Once very hot, lay the steaks into the pan and fry until browned and medium-rare, about 6-8 mins. Turn halfway through.

notes.text: Rump steaks naturally vary in shape, so adjust the following timings depending on how you like yours cooked
Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw meat
Cook each side for 1 min more if you like it more well done

steps.title: Fry your Steaks

points: Meanwhile, finely chop the chives (use scissors if easier). Zest and halve the lime. Trim and halve the green beans.
In a small bowl, add the chives, softened butter and a pinch of lime zest. Using the back of a fork, mash until smooth. Season with a pinch of salt, then set aside.
Once the steaks are cooked, transfer to a board, cover with foil and allow to rest.

notes.text: The steak is safe to eat when browned on the outside

steps.title: Finish the Prep

points: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil with ¼ tsp salt for the peas.
When boiling, add the green beans and peas to the water and cook for 4-5 mins.
Drain in a colander and return to the pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.

Once the potatoes are cooked, drain in a colander and return to the pan, off the heat. Add a knob of butter and a splash of milk (if you have any) and mash until smooth. Season with salt and pepper, then stir in the Italian style cheese.
steps.title: Peas Please

points: When you're ready to serve, cut the steaks widthways into 1cm thick slices, then share between your plates.
Serve the cheesy mash, green beans and peas alongside. Squeeze some lime juice over the peas to taste.
Spread the chive butter over the steaks to finish.
steps.title: Slice and Serve
